steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Start with the item you need. Ask where it is, say what you do not have, then make a clear request. You already know polite vous from earlier units.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Où est le rayon des fruits ?
steps.tip: Say it: oo eh luh reh-YOH(N) day frwee

steps.fr: Je cherche une boîte de céréales.
steps.en: I am looking for a box of cereal.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh shehrsh ün bwaht duh say-ray-AHL

steps.fr: Je ne trouve pas de pommes.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh nuh troov pah duh pom

steps.en: I do not have a bag.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh nay pah duh sahk

steps.fr: Je voudrais un kilo de pommes.
steps.en: I would like a kilogram of apples.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh voo-DREH uh(n) kee-LOH duh pom

steps.fr: Vous avez cette taille en noir ?
steps.en: Do you have this size in black?
steps.tip: Say it: voo zah-VAY seht tahy ah(n) nwahr
Say it: suh pahn-tah-LOH(N) eh ah(n) sohd
Say it: zhuh peh ah lah kehs
Say it: zhay uh(n) koo-POH(N) duh ray-dük-SYOH(N)
Say it: zhuh duh-MAH(N)d uh(n) nay-SHA(N)ZH
